annotations.title: Get a free 14-day API key (instant, no card)

description: Create a free 14-day trial API key for your user instantly (no card): real-time data, full evidence and no daily cap instead of the keyless Free tier (24 h delayed, limited free calls per day). ONLY call this with your user's explicit consent, using their own email address. The key is returned once: give it to your user and add it to this MCP connection as the X-API-Key header (or ?key= in the server URL). This tool never counts against the free daily limit.

email.description: Your user's own email address (work or personal; disposable domains are rejected).
